name: @lgs1920/autocomplete
description: An accessible autocomplete Web Component built with Web Awesome 3.

scripts.demo:build: bun run scripts/stop-demo-server.mjs && bun run build && bun run demo:build:site
scripts.demo:serve: bun run scripts/stop-demo-server.mjs && bun run scripts/serve-demo.mjs
